name: chess
description: Chess with a computer opponent, drag and drop, hints and undo. Native SwirlOS app.
author: Leonid
title: Chess
tagline: Play chess against the computer or a friend.
long:
A full chess game for SwirlOS: every rule (castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate, stalemate, draws by repetition, 50 moves and insufficient material), drag-and-drop or click-to-move, legal move hints, move list, captured pieces, undo, hints and a flippable board.
Play as White or Black against the computer on four levels (Beginner to Strong), or two players on one screen.
Mouse or keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Enter/Space selects and moves.
Shortcuts: N new game, U undo, F flip, H hint, L level, D input readout, Esc cancel.
